prompt_md: Team A beats team B in any one game with chance 60%, independently. What's the chance A wins a best-of-seven series (first to 4 wins)?
prompt_short: 60% per game. Chance to win a best-of-seven?
hint_md: A longer series gives the better team more chances to show it.
explain_intuition_md: It's tempting to think a 60% team wins 60% of series. But a series amplifies small edges: A only loses if it drops 4 of 7 games, and that happens just 29% of the time.
explain_math_md: Imagine all 7 games played (it doesn't change the winner): $$\sum_{k=4}^{7}\binom{7}{k}0.6^k\,0.4^{7-k} \approx 71.0\%$$
